jobs.description:
About Our Client
Notre client est un groupe suisse romand multi-activités reconnu pour la qualité de ses services, sa proximité avec ses clients et sa capacité à évoluer dans un environnement en constante transformation.Présent au travers de plusieurs entités complémentaires, le groupe poursuit une stratégie de développement fondée sur l'innovation, la performance opérationnelle et la création de valeur durable. Son modèle repose sur une forte culture entrepreneuriale, une gestion de proximité et une volonté permanente de satisfaire ses clients. Dans le cadre du renforcement de son équipe de direction, notre client recherche son futur ou sa future Directeur/trice Administratif/ve et Financier/ère . Le poste est basé dans le Canton de Vaud.

Job Description
Pilotage stratégique et accompagnement de la Direction Générale
* Accompagner la Direction Générale dans le développement des différentes unités et contribuer activement à la définition et à la mise en œuvre de la stratégie du groupe.
* Agir en véritable partenaire de la Direction Générale en apportant une vision financière, économique et opérationnelle aux décisions stratégiques, évaluer la rentabilité des activités, identifier les leviers de création de valeur et formuler des recommandations visant à améliorer durablement la performance, notamment dans le cadre de projets de développement, d'investissement et de transformation. Pilotage de la performance et discipline de gestion
* Élaborer les budgets annuels, les prévisions financières et les plans financiers à moyen terme.
* Développer et suivre les indicateurs de performance permettant un pilotage rigoureux de l'activité.
* Accompagner et challenger les directeurs dans l'analyse de leurs résultats, le suivi de leurs objectifs et la mise en œuvre de plans d'actions correctifs.
* Promouvoir une culture de responsabilité, de discipline budgétaire et d'amélioration continue à tous les niveaux de l'organisation.Gestion financière et administrative
* Superviser l'ensemble des fonctions financières, comptables et administratives du groupe.
* Garantir la fiabilité des informations financières ainsi que la qualité du reporting destiné à la Direction Générale et aux instances de gouvernance.
* Assurer une gestion proactive des liquidités, de la trésorerie et des flux financiers.
* Veiller à la bonne allocation des ressources financières et à la maîtrise des risques économiques.Gouvernance, conformité et gestion des risques
* Garantir le respect des obligations fiscales, légales et réglementaires applicables aux différentes entités du groupe.
* Assurer la préparation et la qualité de la documentation financière destinée au Conseil d'Administration.
* Superviser les aspects juridiques du groupe.
* Veiller au renforcement des processus de contrôle interne.Transformation et excellence opérationnelle
* Contribuer à l'optimisation et à l'automatisation des processus administratifs, financiers et des outils de gestion.
* Développer des tableaux de bord et des outils d'aide à la décision permettant de renforcer le pilotage de la performance.
* Participer aux projets de transformation visant à améliorer l'efficacité opérationnelle, la qualité des processus et la fiabilité des données de gestion.
* Instaurer et faire vivre une culture d'exécution, de rigueur et de suivi des engagements au sein de l'organisation.

The Successful Applicant
Formation et expérience
* Formation universitaire en finance, comptabilité, administration des affaires ou discipline équivalente.
* Expérience confirmée de 15 à 20 ans minimum dans des fonctions de direction financière et administrative au sein d'environnements multi-sociétés en Suisse.
* Solide expérience du management d'équipes et de l'accompagnement de dirigeants opérationnels.
* Excellente maîtrise des principes comptables, fiscaux, financiers et réglementaires applicables en Suisse.
* Expérience avérée dans le pilotage de projets stratégiques, de transformation organisationnelle ou d'amélioration de la performance.
* Expérience de la mise en place, de l'évolution et de l'optimisation d'outils de gestion, de reporting et de pilotage décisionnel.Compétences techniques et analytiques
* Capacité à analyser des données financières complexes, à en tirer des enseignements pertinents et à formuler des recommandations stratégiques.
* Excellente maîtrise de la planification financière, de la budgétisation, du contrôle de gestion, du reporting et du pilotage de la performance.
* Forte orientation résultats et capacité à traduire les indicateurs financiers en plans d'actions concrets et mesurables.
* Maîtrise des outils de gestion et des systèmes d'information financiers, avec une sensibilité particulière pour l'automatisation, la digitalisation et l'amélioration continue des processus.Vision stratégique et capacité d'exécution
* Capacité à appréhender les évolutions de l'environnement afin d'anticiper les opportunités et les risques pour l'organisation.
* Aptitude à conjuguer vision stratégique et excellence opérationnelle dans l'exécution.
* Capacité à accompagner la Direction Générale dans la définition, l'adaptation et la mise en œuvre de la stratégie d'entreprise.
* Habitude de piloter des projets transversaux impliquant de multiples parties prenantes et de garantir leur exécution dans le respect des objectifs, des délais et des ressources.
* Esprit entrepreneur, pragmatique et orienté solutions.Leadership et management transversal
* Leadership reconnu permettant de mobiliser les équipes autour d'objectifs communs et de favoriser une culture de responsabilisation, de confiance et de performance.
* Capacité à fédérer des profils variés, à développer les talents et à accompagner le changement.
* Aptitude à challenger de manière constructive les équipes dirigeantes et à promouvoir une culture de discipline de gestion et d'amélioration continue.
* Forte capacité d'influence et aisance dans les environnements matriciels ou complexes nécessitant une collaboration étroite entre différentes fonctions.
* Courage managérial, capacité à prendre des décisions et à faire respecter les priorités et engagements de l'organisation.Rigueur, discipline de gestion et orientation performance
* Reconnu·e pour son exigence, sa rigueur analytique et son sens élevé des responsabilités.
* Capacité à instaurer des processus robustes, des standards de gestion clairs et un suivi rigoureux de la performance.
* Forte culture du pilotage par les indicateurs, du respect des engagements et de l'atteinte des résultats.
* Capacité à structurer, simplifier et améliorer les modes de fonctionnement afin de renforcer durablement l'efficacité de l'organisation.
* Souci constant de la qualité, de la fiabilité des données et de la maîtrise des risques.Communication et relations interpersonnelles
* Excellentes capacités de communication, d'écoute et de persuasion.
* Capacité à adapter son discours à des interlocuteurs variés, du Conseil d'Administration aux responsables opérationnels.
* Aisance relationnelle permettant de créer des relations de confiance avec les différentes parties prenantes internes et externes.
* Diplomatie, finesse et intelligence situationnelle dans la gestion des sujets sensibles ou complexes.
* Capacité à vulgariser des problématiques financières et à rendre les enjeux compréhensibles pour des interlocuteurs non spécialistes.

What's on Offer
L'opportunité de rejoindre une équipe dirigeante engagée et de jouer un rôle déterminant dans le pilotage et la transformation d'un groupe suisse romand reconnu pour son esprit entrepreneurial et sa capacité d'innovation.

Informazioni sul nostro cliente
Il nostro cliente è un gruppo svizzero multi-attività di lingua francese riconosciuto per la qualità dei suoi servizi, la sua vicinanza ai suoi clienti e la sua capacità di evolversi in un ambiente in continua evoluzione. Presente attraverso diverse entità complementari, il gruppo persegue una strategia di sviluppo basata sull'innovazione, sulle prestazioni operative e sulla creazione di valore sostenibile. Il suo modello si basa su una forte cultura imprenditoriale, una gestione della prossimità e una volontà permanente di soddisfare i propri clienti. Come parte del rafforzamento del suo team di gestione, il nostro cliente sta cercando il suo futuro o il suo futuro Amministratore Amministrativo/Ve e Financial/Ear. Il post si trova nel Canton Vaud.

Descrizione del lavoro
Gestione strategica e sostegno della Direzione generale
* Sostenere la Direzione Generale nello sviluppo delle varie unità e contribuire attivamente alla definizione e all'attuazione della strategia del gruppo.
* Agire come vero partner della Direzione Generale fornendo una visione finanziaria, economica e operativa per le decisioni strategiche, valutando la redditività delle attività, identificando leve di creazione di valore e formulando raccomandazioni finalizzate al miglioramento sostenibile delle prestazioni, in particolare nel contesto dei progetti di sviluppo, investimento e trasformazione. Controllo delle prestazioni e disciplina di gestione
* Sviluppare bilanci annuali, previsioni finanziarie e piani finanziari a medio termine.
* Sviluppare e monitorare gli indicatori di performance per una gestione rigorosa dell'attività.
* Supporta e sfida i manager nell'analisi dei loro risultati, nel monitoraggio dei loro obiettivi e nell'attuazione dei piani d'azione correttivi.
* Promuovere una cultura di responsabilità, disciplina di bilancio e miglioramento continuo a tutti i livelli dell'organizzazione.
* Superare tutte le funzioni finanziarie, contabili e amministrative del gruppo.
* Assicurare l'affidabilità delle informazioni finanziarie e la qualità della segnalazione agli organi di direzione generale e di governance.
* Fornire una gestione proattiva dei flussi di cassa, contanti e finanziari.
* Assicurare una corretta ripartizione delle risorse finanziarie e il controllo dei rischi economici. Governance, conformità e gestione dei rischi
* Assicurare il rispetto degli obblighi fiscali, legali e regolamentari applicabili alle diverse entità del gruppo.
* Assicurare la preparazione e la qualità della documentazione finanziaria per il Consiglio di Amministrazione.
* Supervisione degli aspetti giuridici del gruppo.
* Assicurare il rafforzamento dei processi di controllo interno. Trasformazione ed eccellenza operativa
* Contribuire all'ottimizzazione e all'automazione dei processi amministrativi, finanziari e gestionali.
* Sviluppare tabelloni e strumenti di supporto decisionale per rafforzare la gestione delle prestazioni.
* Partecipa a progetti di trasformazione per migliorare l'efficienza operativa, la qualità del processo e l'affidabilità dei dati di gestione.
* Sviluppare e promuovere una cultura di implementazione, rigore e monitoraggio degli impegni all'interno dell'organizzazione.

Il candidato di successo
Formazione ed esperienza
* Formazione universitaria in finanza, contabilità, amministrazione aziendale o disciplina equivalente.
* Esperienza confermata da 15 a 20 anni minimo nelle funzioni di gestione finanziaria e amministrativa in ambienti multi-aziendali in Svizzera.
* Una forte esperienza nella gestione del team e nel supporto dei leader operativi.
* Ottima conoscenza dei principi contabili, fiscali, finanziari e regolamentari applicabili in Svizzera.
* Esperienza nella gestione di progetti strategici, trasformazione organizzativa o miglioramento delle prestazioni.
* Esperienza nella realizzazione, evoluzione e ottimizzazione di strumenti di gestione, reporting e decision-making. Capacità tecniche e analitiche
* Capacità di analizzare dati finanziari complessi, imparare lezioni rilevanti e fare raccomandazioni strategiche.
* Ottimo controllo della pianificazione finanziaria, budgeting, controllo di gestione, reporting e gestione delle prestazioni.
* Forte attenzione ai risultati e alla capacità di tradurre indicatori finanziari in piani d'azione concreti e misurabili.
* Masterizzazione di strumenti di gestione e sistemi informativi finanziari, con una particolare sensibilità per l'automazione, la digitalizzazione e il miglioramento continuo dei processi. Visione strategica e capacità di esecuzione
* Capacità di comprendere gli sviluppi ambientali per anticipare opportunità e rischi per l'organizzazione.
* Capacità di combinare la visione strategica con l'eccellenza operativa nella consegna.
* Capacità di sostenere la Direzione Generale nella definizione, adattamento e attuazione della strategia aziendale.
* Abitudini di pilotare progetti cross-cutting che coinvolgono più stakeholder e garantire la loro attuazione in conformità con obiettivi, scadenze e risorse.
* Imprenditoriali, pragmatici e soluzioni orientate. Leadership e gestione trasversale
* Riconosciuta leadership per mobilitare squadre intorno a obiettivi comuni e promuovere una cultura di responsabilità, fiducia e prestazioni.
* Capacità di federare profili diversi, sviluppare talenti e cambiare supporto.
* Capacità di sfidare costruttivamente la leadership e promuovere una cultura della disciplina di gestione e miglioramento continuo.
* Forte influenza e facilità in ambienti matrice o complessi che richiedono una stretta collaborazione tra diverse funzioni.
* Gestione del coraggio, capacità di prendere decisioni e rispettare le priorità e gli impegni organizzativi. Rigueur, disciplina di gestione e orientamento alle prestazioni
* Riconosciuto per le sue richieste, rigore analitico e alto senso di responsabilità.
* Capacità di stabilire processi robusti, standard di gestione chiari e monitoraggio rigoroso delle prestazioni.
* Forte cultura della leadership degli indicatori, il rispetto degli impegni e il raggiungimento dei risultati.
* Capacità di strutturare, semplificare e migliorare i processi aziendali al fine di migliorare in modo sostenibile l'efficienza organizzativa.
* costante attenzione alla qualità, all'affidabilità dei dati e alla gestione dei rischi Comunicazione e relazioni interpersonali
* Ottima capacità di comunicazione, ascolto e persuasione.
* Capacità di adattare il suo discorso a una varietà di interlocutori, dal Consiglio di Amministrazione ai responsabili operativi.
* Costruire relazioni per costruire fiducia con vari stakeholder interni ed esterni.
* Diplomazia, finezza e intelligenza situazionale nella gestione di soggetti sensibili o complessi.
* Capacità di divulgare le questioni finanziarie e rendere le questioni comprensibili agli interlocutori non specialistici.

Cosa c'è in Offerta
L'opportunità di unire un team di leadership impegnato e di svolgere un ruolo chiave nello sterzo e nella trasformazione di un gruppo francofono svizzero noto per il suo spirito imprenditoriale e la sua capacità di innovazione.

About Our Client
Our customer is a multi-activity, French-speaking Swiss group recognized for the quality of its services, its proximity to its customers and its ability to evolve in a constantly changing environment. Present through several complementary entities, the group pursues a development strategy based on innovation, operational performance and sustainable value creation. Its model is based on a strong entrepreneurial culture, proximity management and a permanent willingness to satisfy its customers. As part of the strengthening of its management team, our client is looking for his future or his future Administrative/Ve and Financial/Ear Director. The post is based in the Canton of Vaud.

Job Description
Strategic management and support of the Directorate-General
* Support the Directorate General in the development of the various units and contribute actively to the definition and implementation of the group's strategy.
* Act as a true partner of the Directorate-General by providing a financial, economic and operational vision for strategic decisions, assessing the profitability of activities, identifying value creation levers and making recommendations aimed at sustainable improvement of performance, particularly in the context of development, investment and transformation projects. Performance control and management discipline
* Develop annual budgets, financial forecasts and medium-term financial plans.
* Develop and monitor performance indicators for rigorous management of the activity.
* Support and challenge managers in analysing their results, monitoring their objectives and implementing corrective action plans.
* Promote a culture of accountability, budgetary discipline and continuous improvement at all levels of the organization.
* Supervise all financial, accounting and administrative functions of the group.
* Ensure the reliability of financial information as well as the quality of reporting to the Directorate-General and governance bodies.
* Provide proactive management of cash, cash and financial flows.
* Ensure proper allocation of financial resources and control of economic risks.Governance, compliance and risk management
* Ensure compliance with the tax, legal and regulatory obligations applicable to the different entities of the group.
* Ensure the preparation and quality of financial documentation for the Board of Directors.
* Supervise the legal aspects of the group.
* Ensure the strengthening of internal control processes.Transformation and operational excellence
* Contribute to the optimization and automation of administrative, financial and management processes.
* Develop scoreboards and decision support tools to strengthen performance management.
* Participate in transformation projects to improve operational efficiency, process quality and reliability of management data.
* Develop and foster a culture of implementation, rigour and monitoring of commitments within the organization.

The Successful Applicant
Training and experience
* University training in finance, accounting, business administration or equivalent discipline.
* Experience confirmed from 15 to 20 years minimum in financial and administrative management functions in multi-company environments in Switzerland.
* Strong experience in team management and support of operational leaders.
* Excellent knowledge of the accounting, tax, financial and regulatory principles applicable in Switzerland.
* Experience in managing strategic projects, organizational transformation or performance improvement.
* Experience in the implementation, evolution and optimization of management, reporting and decision-making tools.Technical and analytical skills
* Ability to analyse complex financial data, learn relevant lessons and make strategic recommendations.
* Excellent control of financial planning, budgeting, management control, reporting and performance management.
* Strong focus on results and ability to translate financial indicators into concrete and measurable action plans.
* Mastery of management tools and financial information systems, with a special sensitivity for automation, digitization and continuous process improvement.Strategic vision and execution capacity
* Ability to understand environmental developments in order to anticipate opportunities and risks for the organisation.
* Ability to combine strategic vision with operational excellence in delivery.
* Ability to support the Directorate General in defining, adapting and implementing the corporate strategy.
* Habits of piloting cross-cutting projects involving multiple stakeholders and ensuring their implementation in accordance with objectives, deadlines and resources.
* Entrepreneurial, pragmatic and solutions oriented.Leadership and cross-cutting management
* Recognized leadership to mobilize teams around common goals and foster a culture of accountability, trust and performance.
* Ability to federate diverse profiles, develop talents and support change.
* Ability to constructively challenge leadership and promote a culture of management discipline and continuous improvement.
* Strong influence and ease in matrix or complex environments requiring close collaboration between different functions.
* Management courage, ability to make decisions and enforce organizational priorities and commitments.Rigueur, management discipline and performance orientation
* Recognized for its demands, analytical rigour and high sense of responsibility.
* Ability to establish robust processes, clear management standards and rigorous performance monitoring.
* Strong culture of indicator leadership, compliance with commitments and achievement of results.
* Ability to structure, simplify and improve business processes in order to sustainably enhance organizational efficiency.
* Constant focus on quality, reliability of data and risk management Communication and interpersonal relationships
* Excellent communication, listening and persuasion skills.
* Ability to tailor his speech to a variety of interlocutors, from the Board of Directors to operational managers.
* Relationship building to build trust with various internal and external stakeholders.
* Diplomacy, finesse and situational intelligence in the management of sensitive or complex subjects.
* Ability to popularize financial issues and make issues understandable to non-specialist interlocutors.

What's on Offer
The opportunity to join a committed leadership team and to play a key role in steering and transforming a Swiss French-speaking group known for its entrepreneurial spirit and innovation capacity.
descriptionByLocale.de:
Über unseren Kunden
Unser Kunde ist eine multiaktive, französischsprachige Schweizer Gruppe, die für die Qualität ihrer Dienstleistungen, ihre Nähe zu ihren Kunden und ihre Fähigkeit, sich in einem sich ständig verändernden Umfeld zu entwickeln, anerkannt ist. Durch mehrere komplementäre Einheiten verfolgt die Gruppe eine Entwicklungsstrategie, die auf Innovation, operativer Leistung und nachhaltiger Wertschöpfung basiert. Sein Modell basiert auf einer starken Unternehmenskultur, einem Proximity Management und einer permanenten Bereitschaft, seine Kunden zufrieden zu stellen. Im Rahmen der Stärkung des Managementteams sucht unser Kunde seine Zukunft oder seinen zukünftigen administrativen / Ve und Finanz- / Ohrdirektor. Die Stelle befindet sich im Kanton Waadt.

Stellenbeschreibung
Strategisches Management und Unterstützung der Generaldirektion
* Unterstützen Sie die Generaldirektion bei der Entwicklung der verschiedenen Einheiten und tragen Sie aktiv zur Festlegung und Umsetzung der Strategie der Gruppe bei.
* Handeln Sie als echter Partner der Generaldirektion, indem Sie eine finanzielle, wirtschaftliche und operative Vision für strategische Entscheidungen liefern, die Rentabilität von Aktivitäten bewerten, Wertschöpfungshebel identifizieren und Empfehlungen zur nachhaltigen Verbesserung der Leistung abgeben, insbesondere im Rahmen von Entwicklungs-, Investitions- und Transformationsprojekten. Leistungskontrolle und Managementdisziplin
* Erstellung von Jahresbudgets, Finanzprognosen und mittelfristigen Finanzplänen.
* Entwicklung und Überwachung von Leistungsindikatoren für ein strenges Management der Tätigkeit.
* Unterstützung und Herausforderung von Managern bei der Analyse ihrer Ergebnisse, der Überwachung ihrer Ziele und der Umsetzung von Korrekturmaßnahmenplänen.
* Förderung einer Kultur der Rechenschaftspflicht, Haushaltsdisziplin und kontinuierlicher Verbesserung auf allen Ebenen der Organisation.
* Beaufsichtigen Sie alle Finanz-, Buchhaltungs- und Verwaltungsfunktionen der Gruppe.
* Gewährleistung der Zuverlässigkeit der Finanzinformationen sowie der Qualität der Berichterstattung an die Generaldirektion und die Leitungsorgane.
* Proaktives Management von Bargeld, Bargeld und Finanzströmen.
* Gewährleistung einer ordnungsgemäßen Verteilung der Finanzmittel und Kontrolle der wirtschaftlichen Risiken. Governance, Compliance und Risikomanagement
* Gewährleistung der Einhaltung der steuerlichen, rechtlichen und regulatorischen Verpflichtungen, die für die verschiedenen Unternehmen der Gruppe gelten.
* Gewährleistung der Erstellung und Qualität der Finanzdokumentation für den Verwaltungsrat.
* Überwachung der rechtlichen Aspekte der Gruppe.
* Stärkung der internen Kontrollprozesse. Transformation und operative Exzellenz
* Beitrag zur Optimierung und Automatisierung von Verwaltungs-, Finanz- und Managementprozessen.
* Entwicklung von Anzeigetafeln und Entscheidungshilfeinstrumenten zur Stärkung des Leistungsmanagements.
* Beteiligen Sie sich an Transformationsprojekten zur Verbesserung der betrieblichen Effizienz, Prozessqualität und Zuverlässigkeit von Managementdaten.
* Entwicklung und Förderung einer Kultur der Umsetzung, Strenge und Überwachung von Verpflichtungen innerhalb der Organisation.

Der erfolgreiche Bewerber
Ausbildung und Erfahrung
* Universitätsausbildung in Finanzen, Rechnungswesen, Betriebswirtschaft oder gleichwertige Disziplin.
* Erfahrung bestätigt von mindestens 15 bis 20 Jahren in Finanz- und Verwaltungsfunktionen in Multi-Unternehmensumgebungen in der Schweiz.
* Starke Erfahrung im Teammanagement und Unterstützung von operativen Führungskräften.
* Ausgezeichnete Kenntnis der in der Schweiz geltenden Rechnungslegungs-, Steuer-, Finanz- und Regulierungsgrundsätze.
* Erfahrung im Management strategischer Projekte, organisatorischer Transformation oder Leistungsverbesserung.
* Erfahrung in der Implementierung, Weiterentwicklung und Optimierung von Management-, Reporting- und Entscheidungsinstrumenten. Technische und analytische Fähigkeiten
* Fähigkeit, komplexe Finanzdaten zu analysieren, relevante Lektionen zu lernen und strategische Empfehlungen abzugeben.
* Ausgezeichnete Kontrolle der Finanzplanung, Budgetierung, Managementkontrolle, Reporting und Performance Management.
* Starke Konzentration auf Ergebnisse und Fähigkeit, Finanzindikatoren in konkrete und messbare Aktionspläne umzusetzen.
* Beherrschung von Management-Tools und Finanzinformationssystemen mit besonderer Sensibilität für Automatisierung, Digitalisierung und kontinuierliche Prozessverbesserung. Strategische Vision und Ausführungskapazität
* Fähigkeit, Umweltentwicklungen zu verstehen, um Chancen und Risiken für die Organisation zu antizipieren.
* Fähigkeit, strategische Vision mit operativer Exzellenz in der Lieferung zu kombinieren.
* Fähigkeit, die Generaldirektion bei der Festlegung, Anpassung und Umsetzung der Unternehmensstrategie zu unterstützen.
* Gewohnheiten der Pilotierung bereichsübergreifender Projekte, an denen mehrere Interessengruppen beteiligt sind, und deren Umsetzung im Einklang mit Zielen, Fristen und Ressourcen sicherzustellen.
* Unternehmerisch, pragmatisch und lösungsorientiert. Führung und Querschnittsmanagement
* Anerkannte Führung, um Teams für gemeinsame Ziele zu mobilisieren und eine Kultur der Rechenschaftspflicht, des Vertrauens und der Leistung zu fördern.
* Fähigkeit, verschiedene Profile zu vereinen, Talente zu entwickeln und Veränderungen zu unterstützen.
* Fähigkeit, die Führung konstruktiv herauszufordern und eine Kultur der Managementdisziplin und der kontinuierlichen Verbesserung zu fördern.
* Starker Einfluss und Leichtigkeit in Matrix- oder komplexen Umgebungen, die eine enge Zusammenarbeit zwischen verschiedenen Funktionen erfordern.
* Führungscourage, Entscheidungsfähigkeit und Durchsetzung organisatorischer Prioritäten und Verpflichtungen. Rigueur, Managementdisziplin und Leistungsorientierung
* Anerkannt für seine Anforderungen, analytische Strenge und hohes Verantwortungsbewusstsein.
* Fähigkeit, robuste Prozesse, klare Managementstandards und strenge Leistungsüberwachung zu etablieren.
* Starke Kultur der Indikatorführerschaft, Einhaltung von Verpflichtungen und Erreichen von Ergebnissen.
* Fähigkeit, Geschäftsprozesse zu strukturieren, zu vereinfachen und zu verbessern, um die organisatorische Effizienz nachhaltig zu steigern.
* Ständiger Fokus auf Qualität, Zuverlässigkeit von Daten und Risikomanagement Kommunikation und zwischenmenschliche Beziehungen
* Hervorragende Kommunikation, Zuhören und Überzeugungsfähigkeiten.
* Fähigkeit, seine Rede auf eine Vielzahl von Gesprächspartnern zuzuschneiden, vom Verwaltungsrat bis hin zu operativen Managern.
* Beziehungsaufbau, um Vertrauen zu verschiedenen internen und externen Stakeholdern aufzubauen.
* Diplomatie, Finesse und situative Intelligenz bei der Verwaltung sensibler oder komplexer Themen.
* Fähigkeit, finanzielle Probleme zu popularisieren und Probleme für nicht spezialisierte Gesprächspartner verständlich zu machen.

Was ist im Angebot
Die Möglichkeit, einem engagierten Führungsteam beizutreten und eine Schlüsselrolle bei der Steuerung und Transformation einer Schweizer französischsprachigen Gruppe zu spielen, die für ihren Unternehmergeist und ihre Innovationsfähigkeit bekannt ist.

jobs.description:
About Our Client
Our client is a well-established international private bank with a strong presence in Switzerland and an international client base. The bank offers a dynamic and multicultural environment and is seeking an experienced Chief Compliance Officer to lead its compliance function from Geneva.

Job Description
The Chief Compliance Officer leads the Compliance function by overseeing compliance, conduct and financial crime risks, ensuring that business activities remain within the Bank's risk appetite and regulatory expectations.
The role requires a combination of deep Swiss regulatory expertise, international private banking experience and strong knowledge of cross-border wealth management activities, including exposure to Latin American, European and Middle Eastern markets and clients.
Key Responsibilities
• Define and implement the Bank's compliance strategy and annual compliance plan, covering conduct risk, regulatory compliance, anti-money laundering, counter-terrorist financing and reputational risk.
• Establish and maintain effective compliance oversight and control frameworks, ensuring compliance risks are appropriately identified, assessed, monitored and reported.
• Lead the development, implementation and enhancement of compliance policies, procedures, controls and governance frameworks.
• Advise senior management and the Board on regulatory requirements, emerging regulatory developments and their impact on the organization.
• Promote a robust compliance management framework, ensuring regular assessment and continuous improvement of compliance processes and controls.
• Act as the primary point of contact for regulators, auditors and other external stakeholders on compliance-related matters.
• Manage regulatory interactions, supervisory reviews and compliance-related information requests.
• Partner with business and support functions to ensure compliance considerations are embedded into key processes and decision making.
• Foster a strong compliance culture through effective communication, training and awareness initiatives across the organization.
• Monitor industry trends, regulatory developments and best practices to ensure ongoing enhancement of the compliance framework.
• Oversee compliance reporting, escalation processes and committee governance, ensuring appropriate oversight and transparency.
• Lead, develop and mentor a high-performing compliance team.

The Successful Applicant
Education
• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Law, Business Administration, Economics, Finance or a related discipline.
• Professional compliance certifications such as ICA, ACAMS, CAS Compliance Management or equivalent are considered advantageous.
Experience
• Minimum 15 years of experience within banking and financial services.
• Proven experience in a senior compliance leadership role within private banking, wealth management or international banking.
• Strong leadership and team management experience.
• Experience with Swiss regulatory frameworks and international private banking activities.
• Exposure to Middle Eastern markets and clients is advantageous.
• Extensive experience managing regulatory interactions and supervisory reviews.
• Demonstrated experience leading compliance transformation, remediation or regulatory change initiatives.
• Strong understanding of cross-border compliance risks, wealth management structures, family offices and international clients.
Skills
• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence senior management, regulators and auditors.
• Strong leadership and people management capabilities.
• Strategic mindset with sound judgement and decision-making skills.
• Ability to thrive in an international and multicultural environment.
• Fluent English and French are mandatory.
• Spanish is considered an advantage.
• Arabic is considered an asset.
• A legal background is beneficial but not essential. Candidates with relevant compliance, risk or banking qualifications and experience are encouraged to apply.

What's on Offer
• Competitive compensation package.
• Hybrid working model with one day of home office per week.
• Opportunity to lead the compliance function of an international private banking institution.
• Exposure to a diverse international client base and cross-border wealth management activities.

Descrizione del lavoro
Il Chief Compliance Officer conduce la funzione Compliance supervisionando i rischi di conformità, condotta e criminalità finanziaria, assicurando che le attività aziendali rimangano all'interno dell'appetito di rischio e delle aspettative normative della Banca.
Il ruolo richiede una combinazione di competenze normative svizzere profonde, esperienza bancaria privata internazionale e una forte conoscenza delle attività di gestione della ricchezza transfrontaliera, tra cui l'esposizione ai mercati e clienti latinoamericani, europei e mediorientale.
Principali responsabilità
• Definire e implementare la strategia di conformità della Banca e il piano di conformità annuale, coprendo il rischio di condotta, la conformità normativa, il riciclaggio di denaro, il finanziamento contro-terrorist e il rischio reputazionale.
• Stabilire e mantenere efficaci quadri di controllo e supervisione della conformità, assicurando che i rischi di conformità siano adeguatamente identificati, valutati, monitorati e segnalati.
• Guidare lo sviluppo, l'attuazione e il miglioramento delle politiche di conformità, procedure, controlli e quadri di governance.

• Agire come punto di contatto principale per i regolatori, i revisori e altri stakeholder esterni in materia di conformità.
• Gestisci le interazioni normative, le recensioni di supervisione e le richieste di informazioni relative alla conformità.

• Controllare i rapporti di conformità, i processi di escalation e la governance dei comitati, assicurando una corretta supervisione e trasparenza.
• Guidare, sviluppare e mentore un team di conformità altamente performante.

Il candidato di successo
Istruzione
• Laurea o Master in Diritto, Business Administration, Economia, Finanza o una disciplina relativa.
• Le certificazioni professionali di conformità come ICA, ACAMS, CAS Compliance Management o equivalente sono considerate vantaggiose.
Esperienza
• Minimo 15 anni di esperienza nei servizi bancari e finanziari.
• Esperienza dimostrata in un ruolo di leadership di conformità senior all'interno di private banking, gestione della ricchezza o bancaria internazionale.
• Forte esperienza di leadership e gestione del team.
• Esperienza con i quadri normativi svizzeri e le attività bancarie private internazionali.
• L'esposizione ai mercati e ai clienti del Medio Oriente è vantaggiosa.
• Ampia esperienza di gestione delle interazioni normative e delle recensioni di supervisione.
• Esperienza dimostrata che conduce le iniziative di trasformazione, bonifica o cambiamento normativo.
• Forte comprensione dei rischi di conformità transfrontalieri, strutture di gestione della ricchezza, uffici familiari e clienti internazionali.
Competenze
• Ottima capacità di comunicazione e gestione degli stakeholder, con la capacità di influenzare la gestione senior, i regolatori e i revisori.
• Forte leadership e capacità di gestione delle persone.
• La mentalità strategica con il giudizio sonoro e le capacità decisionali.
• Capacità di prosperare in un ambiente internazionale e multiculturale.
• Inglese fluente e francese sono obbligatori.
• Lo spagnolo è considerato un vantaggio.
• L'arabo è considerato un bene.
• Uno sfondo legale è benefico ma non essenziale. I candidati con conformità, rischio o qualifiche bancarie pertinenti e l'esperienza sono incoraggiati ad applicare.

Cosa c'è in Offerta
• Pacchetto di compensazione competitivo.
• Modello di lavoro ibrido con un giorno di home office a settimana.
• Opportunità di condurre la funzione di conformità di un istituto bancario privato internazionale.
• Esposizione a una base clienti internazionale diversificata e attività di gestione patrimoniale transfrontaliera.

Der Chief Compliance Officer leitet die Compliance-Funktion, indem er Compliance-, Verhaltens- und Finanzkriminalitätsrisiken überwacht und sicherstellt, dass die Geschäftsaktivitäten im Rahmen der Risikobereitschaft und der regulatorischen Erwartungen der Bank bleiben.

• Festlegung und Umsetzung der Compliance-Strategie und des jährlichen Compliance-Plans der Bank, einschließlich Verhaltensrisiken, Einhaltung gesetzlicher Vorschriften, Bekämpfung der Geldwäsche, Terrorismusfinanzierung und Reputationsrisiken.

• Beratung der Geschäftsleitung und des Vorstands zu regulatorischen Anforderungen, aufkommenden regulatorischen Entwicklungen und deren Auswirkungen auf die Organisation.

jobs.description:
About Our Client
Avec plus de 13'000 collaborateurs et collaboratrices représentant 160 métiers, les Hôpitaux Universitaires de Genève sont un établissement de référence au niveau national et international. Les HUG constituent le principal centre hospitalier universitaire de Suisse et un acteur de référence sur les plans national et international. Ils rassemblent huit hôpitaux publics, deux cliniques et plus de trente sites ambulatoires, regroupant plus de 13 000 collaboratrices et collaborateurs, dont plus de 2 100 médecins et près de 7 300 professionnelles et professionnels des soins. En tant qu'hôpital de proximité pour la population genevoise et institution de référence pour la Suisse romande, les HUG sont rattachés à la Faculté de médecine de l'Université de Genève et perpétuent depuis leur création en 1995 une longue tradition d'excellence dans des domaines tels que les neurosciences, les maladies cardiovasculaires, la médecine génétique ou la chirurgie robotisée. Ils collaborent également avec de nombreuses institutions internationales, dont l'Organisation mondiale de la santé, contribuant ainsi au rayonnement scientifique et médical de Genève.
La Direction des soins incarne l'autorité en matière de soins. Elle a pour mission de garantir la qualité et la sécurité des soins au sein de l'établissement. A ce titre, la Direction des soins a droit de regard sur l'ensemble des activités des soins (personnel infirmier et différents corps professionnels de santé). Pour remplir sa mission, elle s'appuie sur trois directions adjointes en charge de la transformation dans les soins, des pratiques professionnelles et de l'interprofessionnalité.
Les Hôpitaux universitaires de Genève recherchent leur nouveau ou nouvelle Directeur ou Directrice des soins, rôle stratégique avec un impact direct sur la qualité, l'innovation et l'organisation des soins dans une institution engagée dans une transformation dynamique.
Si vous souhaitez rejoindre un environnement mobilisé autour de projets structurants majeurs : digitalisation, intelligence augmentée, modernisation des infrastructures et développement continu de l'excellence clinique et soignante, nous vous prions de bien vouloir nous transmettre votre CV et lettre de motivation (en un seul document PDF) via le formulaire ci-dessous.

Job Description
Dans cette fonction stratégique, vous définissez et conduisez la politique institutionnelle des soins afin de garantir la qualité, la sécurité et l'excellence des prestations au sein des HUG. Membre permanent du comité de direction, vous contribuez activement aux orientations stratégiques de l'institution et accompagnez les transformations nécessaires à l'évolution du système de santé.
Vous développez une vision claire et mobilisatrice des soins, faites évoluer les modèles organisationnels et les pratiques professionnelles, et assurez une gouvernance des soins cohérente et efficace dans un environnement décentralisé. En partenariat étroit avec la Direction médicale, les départements et les filières professionnelles vous renforcez l'interprofessionnalité, le partenariat médico-soignant et la transversalité des prises en charge.
Face aux enjeux majeurs d'attractivité, de relève et de pénurie des professionnels et professionnelles de la santé, vous pilotez les politiques de développement des compétences, de formation et de leadership, tout en soutenant l'académisation des soins et l'émergence de nouveaux rôles professionnels, notamment les pratiques infirmières avancées.
Vous impulsez et dirigez des projets stratégiques, d'innovation et de recherche visant l'amélioration continue de la qualité des prestations. Vous anticipez les évolutions organisationnelles, technologiques et cliniques, tout en intégrant les enjeux de la transition écologique dans les soins.
Vous représentez l'autorité soignante auprès des instances internes et externes, des partenaires institutionnels et des associations professionnelles. Attentif ou attentive aux enjeux politiques, institutionnels et sanitaires, vous entretenez un dialogue constructif avec les partenaires sociaux et contribuez au rayonnement des HUG auprès des réseaux professionnels et académiques régionaux et nationaux.

The Successful Applicant

About Our Client
With more than 13,000 employees representing 160 professions, the University Hospitals in Geneva are a reference institution at the national and international level. The HUGs are Switzerland's leading university hospital centre and a leading national and international actor. They bring together eight public hospitals, two clinics and more than 30 outpatient sites, bringing together more than 13,000 collaborators, including more than 2,100 doctors and nearly 7,300 professional and professional care workers. As a local hospital for the Geneva population and a reference institution for French-speaking Switzerland, the HUGs have been attached to the Faculty of Medicine at the University of Geneva and, since their creation in 1995, have maintained a long tradition of excellence in areas such as neuroscience, cardiovascular disease, genetic medicine and robotic surgery. They also collaborate with many international institutions, including the World Health Organization, contributing to the scientific and medical outreach of Geneva.
The Care Branch embodies the authority for care. Its mission is to ensure the quality and safety of care within the institution. As such, the Directorate of Care has the right to look at all the activities of care (nursing staff and various health professional bodies). To fulfill its mission, it relies on three Assistant Directorates in charge of transformation in care, professional practices and interprofessionality.
The University Hospitals in Geneva are looking for their new or new Director or Director of Care, a strategic role with a direct impact on quality, innovation and the organization of care in an institution undergoing a dynamic transformation.
If you wish to join an environment mobilized around major structuring projects: digitalisation, enhanced intelligence, infrastructure modernization and the continued development of clinical and healthcare excellence, please send us your CV and cover letter (in a single PDF document) via the form below.

Job Description
In this strategic function, you define and drive the institutional care policy to ensure the quality, safety and excellence of services within the HUGs. As a permanent member of the Executive Committee, you are actively contributing to the strategic directions of the institution and accompanying the changes necessary for the evolution of the health system.
You develop a clear and mobilising vision of care, evolve organizational models and professional practices, and ensure coherent and effective care governance in a decentralized environment. In close partnership with the Medical Directorate, departments and professional sectors, you strengthen interprofessionality, the medical-care partnership and the cross-sectionality of care.
Faced with the major challenges of attractiveness, succession and shortage of health professionals and professionals, you are leading skills development, training and leadership policies, while supporting the academicization of care and the emergence of new professional roles, including advanced nursing practices.
You drive and lead strategic, innovation and research projects aimed at continuously improving the quality of services. You anticipate organizational, technological and clinical developments, while integrating the challenges of ecological transition into care.
You represent the health care authority in internal and external bodies, institutional partners and professional associations. Attentive or attentive to political, institutional and health issues, you have a constructive dialogue with the social partners and contribute to the outreach of HUGs to regional and national professional and academic networks.

The Successful Applicant
You have a university degree in nursing or health, complemented by a graduate degree in management, leadership or management of organizations. You benefit from a proven experience in strategic leadership roles within a large hospital facility, ideally university, and master the challenges of complex, multidisciplinary and highly matrician environments.
You have strong expertise in care governance and proven experience in defining and deploying care policies at the institutional level. You are able to evolve organizations, while preserving the missions and institutional values, and have demonstrated experience in conducting major transformations, accompanying teams in complex contexts of change.
Your organizational management skills are recognized: leadership of human and financial resources, workload analysis, organization optimization, change management and multi-stakeholder coordination. With your ability to analyze, discern and listen, you make informed decisions in constantly changing environments. You are consistent between your decisions, actions and values.
You have demonstrated your ability to develop strong medical-care partnerships, based on complementary expertise and the pursuit of common goals. Recognized for your unifying leadership, you know how to mobilize teams, create commitment around a common vision and foster collaboration among stakeholders with sometimes divergent interests.
You master the issues related to the attractiveness of the healthcare professions, the retention of collaborators, the development of talents and the preparation of succession in a context marked by the shortage of health professionals. You have a strong interest in skills development, training and academization of care, and have close collaborations with academic and professional partners.
You encourage the development of clinical research, innovation and forward-looking approaches. Sensitive to the evolution of the health system, you are interested in the challenges of digital transformation, artificial intelligence and the integration of new technologies for the quality of care, the efficiency of organizations and the experience of patients.
You have an excellent understanding of the political, institutional and health issues that influence health organizations. You are recognized for your qualities of communication, negotiation and institutional representation and know how to develop trusting relationships with internal and external partners, authorities, professional networks and social partners.
Finally, you have great relational intelligence, a strong capacity for influence and managerial courage. At ease in the displayed functions, you can manage a significant workload, evolve in challenging contexts and cope with pressure while maintaining a strategic vision and high capacity for action.

Face aux enjeux majeurs d'attractivité, de relève et de pénurie des professionnels et professionnelles de la santé, vous pilotez les politiques de développement des compétences, de formation et de leadership, tout en soutenant l'académisation des soins et l'émergence de nouveaux rôles professionnels, notamment les pratiques infirmières avancées.
Vous impulsez et dirigez des projets stratégiques, d'innovation et de recherche visant l'amélioration continue de la qualité des prestations. Vous anticipez les évolutions organisationnelles, technologiques et cliniques, tout en intégrant les enjeux de la transition écologique dans les soins.
Vous représentez l'autorité soignante auprès des instances internes et externes, des partenaires institutionnels et des associations professionnelles. Attentif ou attentive aux enjeux politiques, institutionnels et sanitaires, vous entretenez un dialogue constructif avec les partenaires sociaux et contribuez au rayonnement des HUG auprès des réseaux professionnels et académiques régionaux et nationaux.

The Successful Applicant
Vous êtes titulaire d'un diplôme universitaire en sciences infirmières ou en santé, complété par une formation de niveau supérieur en management, leadership ou gestion des organisations. Vous bénéficiez d'une expérience confirmée dans des fonctions de direction stratégique au sein d'un établissement hospitalier de grande envergure, idéalement universitaire, et maîtrisez les enjeux propres aux environnements complexes, multidisciplinaires et fortement matriciels.
Vous possédez une solide expertise en gouvernance des soins ainsi qu'une expérience avérée dans la définition et le déploiement de politiques de soins à l'échelle institutionnelle. Vous êtes capable de faire évoluer les organisations, tout en préservant les missions et les valeurs institutionnelles, et disposez d'une expérience démontrée dans la conduite de transformations d'envergure, d'accompagnement des équipes dans des contextes de changement complexes.
Vos compétences en gestion organisationnelle sont reconnues : pilotage des ressources humaines et financières, analyse des charges de travail, optimisation des organisations, conduite du changement et coordination d'acteurs multiples. Grâce à vos capacités d'analyse, de discernement et d'écoute, vous prenez des décisions éclairées dans des environnements en constante évolution. Vous faites preuve de cohérence entre vos décisions, vos actions et les valeurs que vous portez.
Vous avez démontré votre capacité à développer des partenariats médico-soignants solides, fondés sur la complémentarité des expertises et la recherche d'objectifs communs. Reconnu-e pour votre leadership fédérateur, vous savez mobiliser les équipes, créer l'adhésion autour d'une vision commune et favoriser la collaboration entre des parties prenantes aux intérêts parfois divergents.
Vous maîtrisez les enjeux liés à l'attractivité des professions soignantes, à la fidélisation des collaborateurs et collaboratrices, au développement des talents ainsi qu'à la préparation de la relève dans un contexte marqué par la pénurie des professionnels et professionnelles de la santé. Vous portez un intérêt marqué au développement des compétences, à la formation et à l'académisation des soins, et entretenez des collaborations étroites avec les partenaires académiques et professionnels.
Vous encouragez le développement de la recherche clinique, l'innovation et les démarches prospectives. Sensible aux évolutions du système de santé, vous vous intéressez aux enjeux de transformation numérique, d'intelligence artificielle et d'intégration des nouvelles technologies au service de la qualité des soins, de l'efficience des organisations et de l'expérience des patients et patientes.
Vous disposez d'une excellente compréhension des enjeux politiques, institutionnels et sanitaires qui influencent les organisations de santé. Vous êtes reconnu-e pour vos qualités de communication, de négociation et de représentation institutionnelle et savez développer des relations de confiance avec les partenaires internes et externes, les autorités, les réseaux professionnels et les partenaires sociaux.
Enfin, vous faites preuve d'une grande intelligence relationnelle, d'une forte capacité d'influence et de courage managérial. À l'aise dans les fonctions exposées, vous savez gérer une charge de travail importante, évoluer dans des contextes exigeants et faire face à la pression tout en maintenant une vision stratégique et une capacité d'action élevée.

jobs.description:
About Our Client
Our client, a well-established Swiss private bank with a long-standing heritage in wealth management, is seeking an experienced Senior Private Banker to join its growing teams in multiple locations .
This is an opportunity for entrepreneurial banking professionals with an established network and portable client relationships to join a highly reputable Swiss institution that offers autonomy, flexibility, and direct access to decision-makers.

Job Description
• Acquire, develop and manage a portfolio of High Net Worth (HNW) and Ultra High Net Worth (UHNW) clients.
• Build long-term client relationships through tailored wealth management solutions.
• Identify new business opportunities and drive assets under management growth.
• Deliver comprehensive investment, wealth planning and advisory solutions.
• Ensure full compliance with Swiss and cross-border regulatory requirements.
• Collaborate closely with investment specialists and senior management to deliver best-in-class client service.

The Successful Applicant
• Minimum 10 years of proven success as a Private Banker / Relationship Manager in Switzerland .
• Strong and stable track record of client acquisition and relationship management.
• Demonstrable network within Switzerland, Europe and/or the Middle East .
• Strong understanding of financial markets, investment products and wealth management solutions.
• Excellent knowledge of Swiss and cross-border regulations.
• CWMA-SAQ certification or equivalent qualification preferred.
• Entrepreneurial, self-driven and capable of working independently.
• Resident in Switzerland or eligible to work in Switzerland.
• We are particularly interested in professionals covering:
•
• Switzerland
• Western and Northern Europe
• Southern Europe
• Middle East (GCC markets especially welcomed)

What's on Offer
• The stability and reputation of an established Swiss private banking platform.
• A genuinely entrepreneurial environment with substantial autonomy.
• Direct access to senior leadership and swift decision-making processes.
• Competitive and direct performance-driven remuneration structure.
• Flexible and supportive platform for experienced bankers looking to grow their business.
• Long-term commitment to relationship-driven private banking.

jobs.description:
About Our Client
Notre client est un acteur dans le secteur des services financiers, reconnu pour la qualité de son positionnement sur des marchés reconnus. Il intervient sur l'ensemble de la chaîne de valeur, au service d'une clientèle fidèle.
Dans un contexte de transformation soutenue, notre client poursuit une stratégie ambitieuse alliant croissance, innovation et renforcement de ses fonctions de pilotage. L'environnement de travail se distingue par un haut niveau d'exigence, une forte exposition aux enjeux réglementaires et une volonté constante d'amélioration des processus et des outils.
Rejoindre cette organisation, c'est intégrer une structure solide et en évolution, offrant des perspectives de développement au sein d'une fonction finance au cœur des enjeux stratégiques du Groupe.

Job Description
Rattaché à la direction financière, vous intervenez au cœur des activités du Groupe avec une responsabilité sur un périmètre comptable étendu. Vous encadrez une équipe dédiée et assurez la qualité, la cohérence et la transparence de l'ensemble des informations financières produites.Ce poste offre une exposition large aux différentes activités et constitue une opportunité naturelle de transition pour un profil expérimenté issu de l'audit externe (niveau Senior Manager minimum), souhaitant évoluer vers un rôle opérationnel avec une dimension managériale et stratégique.Vous contribuez activement à la production et à la fiabilité de l'information financière du Groupe, en assurant notamment :
• La coordination des travaux de clôture périodique et la sécurisation des livrables financiers dans des délais contraints
• La préparation et la revue des comptes ainsi que des états consolidés
• Le suivi des référentiels comptables applicables à l'activité et leur bonne mise en œuvre au sein des entités
Vous supervisez également les processus permettant de garantir une lecture consolidée de la performance :
• Organisation des cycles de consolidation et validation des données remontées
• Production d'analyses destinées aux instances de direction et aux organismes de supervision
• Contribution à la qualité et à la pertinence du reporting financier
Dans un environnement fortement régulé, vous participez à la maîtrise des risques financiers :
• Interaction régulière avec les fonctions de contrôle et les parties prenantes externes
• Suivi des obligations réglementaires applicables
• Encadrement des sujets fiscaux en lien avec des experts spécialisés
Vous jouez enfin un rôle actif dans l'évolution de la fonction finance :
• Optimisation des processus et renforcement des dispositifs de contrôle
• Participation à des projets d'amélioration des outils et des systèmes
• Contribution aux initiatives de transformation et d'automatisation
En tant que manager, vous accompagnez vos collaborateurs dans leur développement :
• Organisation et pilotage de l'activité de l'équipe
• Développement des compétences et montée en expertise
• Mise en place d'un environnement de travail structuré et collaboratif.

The Successful Applicant
Vous justifiez d'une expérience significative en finance, acquise au sein d'un cabinet d'audit de premier plan, d'une structure de services financiers ou d'un environnement comparable.
Une expérience en audit externe à un niveau avancé constitue un atout particulièrement pertinent pour ce poste, notamment dans une logique de transition vers des responsabilités opérationnelles.
Vous disposez par ailleurs :
• D'une solide compréhension des problématiques de production financière et de consolidation
• D'une bonne maîtrise des environnements multi-entités et multi-devises
• D'une capacité à appréhender des activités financières diversifiées et leurs impacts comptables
• D'une aisance avec les systèmes d'information financiers et les outils de reporting
• Capacité à encadrer et structurer une équipe
• Exigence élevée en matière de qualité et de fiabilité
• Esprit d'analyse et sens critique développé
• Capacité à prendre du recul et à prioriser dans un environnement complexe
• Goût pour l'amélioration continue et les environnements en transformation
• Aptitude à interagir avec des interlocuteurs variés

What's on Offer
Opportunité de rejoindre une structure reconnue pour son excellence.

• Produzione di analisi per gli organismi di gestione e di controllo
• Contributo alla qualità e alla pertinenza della rendicontazione finanziaria

• Monitoraggio degli obblighi normativi applicabili
• Orientamento sulle questioni fiscali relative agli esperti specializzati

• Ottimizzazione dei processi e rafforzamento dei controlli
• Partecipazione a progetti di miglioramento di strumenti e sistemi
• Contributo alle iniziative di trasformazione e automazione
Come manager, supporti i tuoi dipendenti nel loro sviluppo:
• Organizzazione e gestione delle attività del team
• Sviluppo delle competenze e maggiore competenza
• Creazione di un ambiente di lavoro strutturato e collaborativo

Lei giustifica un'esperienza finanziaria significativa, acquisita in una società di audit leader, struttura dei servizi finanziari o ambiente comparabile.
L'esperienza nell'audit esterno a livello avanzato è un asset particolarmente rilevante per questa posizione, tra cui una transizione alle responsabilità operative.
Hai anche:
• Una forte comprensione delle questioni di produzione finanziaria e di consolidamento
• Una buona padronanza degli ambienti multi-entity e multi-valuta
• Una capacità di catturare attività finanziarie diversificate e i loro impatti contabili
• Facile con sistemi informativi finanziari e strumenti di reporting
• Capacità di incastrare e strutturare un team
• Requisiti di alta qualità e affidabilità
• Spirito analitico e senso critico sviluppato
• Capacità di tornare indietro e priorità in un ambiente complesso
• Gusto per ambienti di miglioramento e trasformazione continui
• Capacità di interagire con vari interlocutori

Opportunità di unire una struttura riconosciuta per la sua eccellenza.
descriptionByLocale.en:
About Our Client
Our customer is a player in the financial services sector, recognized for the quality of its positioning in recognized markets. It operates throughout the value chain, serving a loyal clientele.
In a context of sustained transformation, our customer is pursuing an ambitious strategy combining growth, innovation and strengthening of its steering functions. The work environment is characterized by a high level of requirement, high exposure to regulatory issues and a constant desire to improve processes and tools.
Joining this organization is integrating a solid and evolving structure, providing development opportunities within a finance function at the heart of the Group's strategic stakes.

Attached to the financial management, you intervene at the heart of the Group's activities with a responsibility over a broad accounting area. You frame a dedicated team and ensure the quality, consistency and transparency of all financial information produced. This position offers a wide exposure to different activities and is a natural transition opportunity for an experienced profile from external audit (minimum Senior Manager level), wishing to evolve towards an operational role with a managerial and strategic dimension. You actively contribute to the production and reliability of the Group's financial information, including:
• Coordination of periodic closure work and securing financial deliverables within time constraints
• Preparation and review of accounts and consolidated statements
• Monitoring of accounting frameworks applicable to the activity and their proper implementation within entities
You also oversee processes to ensure a consolidated reading of performance:
• Organization of consolidation cycles and validation of reported data
• Production of analyses for management and supervisory bodies
• Contribution to the quality and relevance of financial reporting
In a highly regulated environment, you participate in controlling financial risks:
• Regular interaction with oversight functions and external stakeholders
• Monitoring of applicable regulatory obligations
• Guidance on tax matters related to specialist experts
Finally, you play an active role in the evolution of the finance function:
• Optimization of processes and strengthening of controls
• Participation in tools and systems improvement projects
• Contribution to transformation and automation initiatives
As a manager, you support your employees in their development:
• Organization and management of team activity

About Our Client
Our client is a diversified international organization undergoing an important phase of strategic growth and transformation. Backed by a strong innovation agenda and a global operational footprint, the company is investing in new commercial opportunities, emerging technologies and future-oriented business models driven by AI to accelerate its next stage of development.

Reporting to the top management, the VP Strategic Ventures & AI will be responsible for identifying, developing and scaling new commercial opportunities beyond the organization's established core activities.The role focuses on transforming innovative technologies, digital solutions, artificial intelligence capabilities and proprietary data assets into sustainable business offerings targeting adjacent markets, industries and customer segments.

• Define the lifecycle management and improve operational performance through clear customer initiatives with a value proposition.
• Define strategy and market opportunities, develop go-to-market approaches, establish strategic partnerships and oversee the commercialization of new services and solutions on a global scale.
This is a highly visible position combining strategic thinking with hands-on business building responsibilities.

The Successful Applicant
• Master's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Data Science, Business or MBA
• Proven experience in business development, strategic growth, commercialization, innovation or new venture creation within an industrial, technology, engineering or infrastructure related environment.
• Track record of launching and scaling technology enabled solutions and products to market.
• Experience with new venture markets, services and building a new product from idea to commercialization
• Strong understanding of digital technologies, data-driven solutions and AI applications in industrial settings.
• Ability to engage and influence senior executives, customers and strategic partners internationally.
• Experience in the commercial design, pricing, negotiation, IP framing and go-to-market execution.
• Strong commercial acumen combined with strategic, analytical and entrepreneurial capabilities.
• Advanced degree in Engineering, Business, Technology or a related discipline preferred.
• Fluent in English required; additional languages are considered an asset.

What's on Offer
• A unique opportunity to shape and lead a global growth agenda at the intersection of technology, innovation and business strategy from scratch
• High visibility within the executive leadership team and direct exposure to key strategic initiatives.

jobs.description:
About Our Client
Our client is a leading international investment and asset management firm with a strong reputation across global wealth management, institutional investment solutions and active asset management. With a culture that combines entrepreneurial thinking, financial discipline and long-term value creation, the organization offers a dynamic and high-performance environment where finance plays a key role in shaping business strategy.The position can be based in either Zurich or London , providing exposure to senior stakeholders across multiple jurisdictions and investment platforms.

Job Description
As the Senior Finance Business Partner for the division, you will act as a trusted advisor to senior management while maintaining an independent finance perspective. You will translate strategic initiatives, commercial developments and investment priorities into clear financial recommendations that support informed decision-making.A key component of the role will be leading the budgeting, forecasting and long-term planning processes. You will develop and challenge financial assumptions linked to assets under management, net new money, revenue margins, product profitability, operating expenses and strategic initiatives. Working closely with business leaders and corporate functions, you will ensure that planning outcomes are aligned with both strategic objectives and financial targets.You will own the financial performance dialogue with senior business stakeholders, providing insightful analysis of revenues, margins, costs, headcount development and profitability drivers. Through rigorous analysis and effective communication, you will identify opportunities, highlight risks and propose actions to enhance business performance.The role also encompasses the assessment of strategic projects, investment cases, hiring plans, technology initiatives and business development opportunities. You will evaluate financial returns, risks, implementation considerations and resource requirements, ensuring robust business cases and disciplined capital allocation.In addition, you will contribute to strengthening governance, financial transparency and performance management frameworks while partnering closely with FP&A, Risk, Accounting, Treasury, Tax, HR and other key stakeholders. As a senior member of the finance organization, you will help promote a strong business partnering culture and contribute to the development of best practices across the finance function.

The Successful Applicant
The ideal candidate brings significant experience in Finance Business Partnering, FP&A, Controlling or Management Consulting within the Asset Management or Institutional Investment sphere.You possess a deep understanding of investment management economics, including assets under management, fund flows, revenue margins, product profitability and cost structures. You are comfortable operating in complex, international organizations and have a proven ability to influence senior stakeholders through data-driven insight and constructive challenge.A university degree in Finance, Economics or Business Administration is expected, while qualifications such as CFA, CPA, ACA or ACCA will be viewed favourably. You combine strong financial modelling and analytical capabilities with excellent communication skills. Given the international scope of the role, perfect written and spoken English is essential.

What's on Offer
• A highly visible finance leadership role with direct exposure to senior executives and investment leaders.
• An entrepreneurial and collaborative culture that values initiative, innovation and ownership.
• International career development opportunities in either Zurich or London.
• Competitive compensation and benefits package commensurate with experience.
• Broad exposure to investment management, institutional clients and corporate strategy.
• Ideal platform for finance professionals seeking a blend of commercial, strategic and analytical responsibilities.

Informazioni sul nostro cliente
Il nostro cliente è una società di investimento e gestione patrimoniale internazionale leader con una forte reputazione nella gestione globale della ricchezza, soluzioni di investimento istituzionali e gestione attiva degli asset. Con una cultura che combina il pensiero imprenditoriale, la disciplina finanziaria e la creazione di valore a lungo termine, l'organizzazione offre un ambiente dinamico e ad alte prestazioni in cui la finanza svolge un ruolo chiave nella definizione della strategia aziendale. La posizione può essere basata sia a Zurigo che a Londra, fornendo l'esposizione agli stakeholder senior attraverso più giurisdizioni e piattaforme di investimento.

Descrizione del lavoro
Come Senior Finance Business Partner per la divisione, si agirà come consulente di fiducia per la gestione senior, mantenendo una prospettiva finanziaria indipendente. Tradurrà iniziative strategiche, sviluppi commerciali e priorità di investimento in chiare raccomandazioni finanziarie che sostengono il processo decisionale informato. Una componente chiave del ruolo sarà la guida dei processi di budgeting, forecasting e pianificazione a lungo termine. Svilupperai e sfiderai presupposti finanziari legati ai beni in gestione, netti nuovi soldi, margini di reddito, redditività del prodotto, spese operative e iniziative strategiche. Lavorando a stretto contatto con i leader aziendali e le funzioni aziendali, si assicurerà che i risultati di pianificazione siano allineati con obiettivi strategici e obiettivi finanziari. Possiederai il dialogo sulle prestazioni finanziarie con gli stakeholder aziendali senior, fornendo un'analisi approfondita dei ricavi, dei margini, dei costi, dello sviluppo dei conti e dei driver di redditività. Attraverso analisi rigorose e comunicazione efficace, si identificano opportunità, evidenziare rischi e proporre azioni per migliorare le prestazioni aziendali. Il ruolo comprende anche la valutazione di progetti strategici, casi di investimento, piani di assunzione, iniziative tecnologiche e opportunità di sviluppo aziendale. Valuterai i rendimenti finanziari, i rischi, le considerazioni di implementazione e i requisiti delle risorse, garantendo robusti casi di business e allocazione dei capitali disciplinati. Contribuirai inoltre a rafforzare la governance, la trasparenza finanziaria e la gestione delle prestazioni, collaborando con FP&A, Risk, Accounting, Treasury, Tax, HR e altri stakeholder chiave. Come membro senior dell'organizzazione finanziaria, vi aiuterà a promuovere una forte cultura di partner commerciale e contribuire allo sviluppo delle migliori pratiche in tutta la funzione di finanza.

Il candidato di successo
Il candidato ideale porta un'esperienza significativa in Finance Business Partnering, FP&A, Controlling o Management Consulting all'interno della Asset Management o della sfera di Investimento Istituzionale. Possiedi una profonda comprensione dell'economia di gestione degli investimenti, compresi i beni in gestione, i flussi di fondi, i margini di reddito, la redditività del prodotto e le strutture di costo. Sei a tuo agio a operare in organizzazioni complesse e internazionali e hai una comprovata capacità di influenzare gli stakeholder senior attraverso la comprensione data-driven e la sfida costruttiva. Si prevede una laurea in Finanza, Economia o Business Administration, mentre le qualifiche come CFA, CPA, ACA o ACCA saranno visualizzate favorevolmente. Unisci forte modellazione finanziaria e capacità analitiche con eccellenti capacità di comunicazione. Data la portata internazionale del ruolo, l'inglese perfetto scritto e parlato è essenziale.

Cosa c'è in Offerta
• Un ruolo di leadership finanziaria altamente visibile con esposizione diretta ai dirigenti senior e ai leader di investimento.
• Una cultura imprenditoriale e collaborativa che valorizza l'iniziativa, l'innovazione e la proprietà.
• Opportunità di sviluppo della carriera internazionale a Zurigo o Londra.
• Il pacchetto di compensazione e benefici competitivi è commisurato all'esperienza.
• Ampia esposizione alla gestione degli investimenti, ai clienti istituzionali e alla strategia aziendale.
• Piattaforma ideale per i professionisti della finanza alla ricerca di una miscela di responsabilità commerciali, strategiche e analitiche.

Vous combinez de solides capacités de modélisation financière et d'analyse avec d'excellentes compétences en communication. Compte tenu de la portée internationale du rôle, l'anglais parfait écrit et parlé est essentiel.

As a member of the senior leadership team, the Managing Director will contribute to the further development, professionalisation and expansion of the organisation. The position combines broad commercial leadership with responsibility for selected corporate and financial matters. Working closely with the main shareholder, the successful candidate will help translate the company's strategic ambitions into a scalable operating model.Key responsibilities will include:
• Contributing to the definition and execution of the company's growth strategy.
• Developing the organisation's commercial presence and routes to market in a Be2Be environment
• Building and strengthening strategic relationships with commercial partners, service providers and other relevant stakeholders.
• Structuring and scaling the company's partnership-management capabilities.
• Supporting the development of new markets, channels and business opportunities.
• Establishing clear commercial objectives, performance indicators and management processes.
• Building financial planning, controlling, reporting and performance management.
• Monitoring profitability, cash flow and the overall financial performance of the business.
• Contributing to the ongoing development of governance, organisational and decision-making structures.
• Supporting the coordination and performance management of activities across different markets.
• Building and developing teams and leadership capabilities as the organisation grows.
• Ensuring that commercial growth is supported by appropriate financial discipline and organizational structures.
• Acting as a trusted sparring partner to the shareholder
• Build and develop a lean team
The role will require a combination of strategic perspective and hands-on involvement. It offers the opportunity to influence the next stage of development of a business operating in a dynamic, consumer-oriented environment.

The Successful Applicant
The successful candidate will be a builder with an entrepreneurial and commercially mindsete with the ability to operate across strategy, business development, finance and organisational leadership.
The profile should ideally include:
• Senior leadership experience as a Managing Director, CEO, Commercial Director, or commercial CFO or in a comparable scale-up environment
• A successful track record in building, scaling a business to an institutional level, business unit or commercial organisation.
• Relevant exposure to travel, tourism, hospitality, leisure, retail, consumer services, e-commerce, digital platforms or marketplace businesses .
• Experience developing and managing B2B, B2B2C or partner-led commercial models.
• Demonstrated ability to build relationships with independent commercial partners, distributors, agents, franchisees, affiliates or service providers.
• Strong commercial judgement, including experience in business development, partner acquisition and the long-term development of partner performance.
• Solid financial capabilities across planning, budgeting, controlling, reporting, liquidity management and profitability analysis.
• Previous exposure to international, multi-site, decentralised or multi-entity organisations.
• Strong analytical and strategic capabilities, combined with a pragmatic and execution-oriented approach.
• Experience working with digital products, platforms or technology-enabled business models.
• A leadership style characterised by integrity, resilience, sound judgement and a genuine willingness to build.
• Only fluent German can be considered on top of very good command of English.
• Willingness to travel regularly.

• Sostenere lo sviluppo di nuovi mercati, canali e opportunità di business.
• Stabilire obiettivi commerciali chiari, indicatori di performance e processi di gestione.

• Monitoraggio della redditività, del flusso di cassa e delle prestazioni finanziarie globali del business.
• Contribuire allo sviluppo continuo di strutture di governance, organizzative e decisionali.

• Costruire e sviluppare team e capacità di leadership come l'organizzazione cresce.
• Assicurarsi che la crescita commerciale è sostenuta da una disciplina finanziaria appropriata e strutture organizzative.
